headline: MacBook Pro overhaul: entry-level model to gain new design sooner than expected
summary: Apple's entry-level MacBook Pro is reportedly getting a significant design refresh and an M7 chip, arriving earlier than initially anticipated according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.
details: Apple is reportedly planning a significant overhaul for its entry-level MacBook Pro, which is expected to feature a new design and be powered by an M7 chip. This update, revealed by Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, is anticipated to arrive sooner than previously expected.

Currently, the entry-level MacBook Pro retains an older design compared to its higher-end counterparts. The upcoming refresh suggests it will adopt the modern aesthetic seen in the more premium MacBook Pro models, bringing a unified look across the lineup.

headline_marked: [[AI agents hold live stand-up meetings]] in Claude Code sessions at zero token cost
headline: AI agents hold live stand-up meetings in Claude Code sessions at zero token cost
summary: Agent Standup transforms Claude Code sessions into interactive team meetings for AI agents, allowing you to track progress and blockers without incurring additional token costs.
details: Agent Standup introduces a novel way for AI agents to collaborate within Claude Code sessions, transforming them into live team meetings. This feature allows users to monitor agent progress and identify blockers without incurring any additional token costs.

The system simulates a team meeting where a 'lead' agent gives orders, and 'sub-agents' join to share their screens and report back on their tasks. This provides a real-time overview of the development process.

Described as 'a bit silly' but 'weirdly useful,' Agent Standup offers a dynamic, live experience complete with voices, mirroring the actual session workflow. It aims to enhance transparency in AI-driven development.
To utilize Agent Standup, users must have previously engaged with Claude Code on their machine at least once. This ensures seamless integration with existing Claude development environments.
